heading: List of Tests Available
lede: Search our laboratory test directory. Reporting times and specimen requirements shown — rates withheld from public UI per project policy.

tests.name: Liver function test

description.text: Liver function test is a laboratory investigation used to support metabolic and organ function. The test is performed on serum (clotted vial).
Your clinician may order this test to help diagnose, monitor, or rule out conditions related to your symptoms and medical history.

preparation.text: Fast for 10–12 hours before sample collection. Water is permitted.
Avoid alcohol and heavy meals the evening before the test.

tests.sampleInstructions: Blood is drawn into a clotted (gold/red-top) tube, allowed to clot, then centrifuged for serum separation.
tests.reportDelivery: Results are usually available within 24 Hrs during routine working hours. Urgent or critical results are communicated directly to the referring clinician.
tests.availability: Sample collection: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM. Reporting times may vary on Sundays and public holidays.
